fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_10.m: Hello there. Please do not bother me, I have a lot of work to do.
r: Can I have just one minute of your time, please?
Could you tell me the story about the wicked witch again?
Great! I was wondering if you know anything about a kidnapping or a witch?

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_30.m: [Taken aback by the question] What did you just ask me?
r: I asked if you know anything about a witch and the possibility that she took a girl.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_40.m: Leave me alone! I don't want to talk about her!
r: So you know something about the kidnapping?
What about the witch? Do you know something about her?

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_50.m: I may, but I don't want to tell you about her as I am terrified of her.
r: Wow! Now I have to learn what you know. Please tell me your story.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_60.m: No way! I have no way to protect myself and believe me, I will need to if I tell you anything.
r: I will protect you. Trust me.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_65.m: [Laughing uncontrollably] ... You? You are just a child of a farmer. So you are weaker than I am.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_66.m: Of course I do. He lives a stones throw away from me and we are both farmers.
r: Oh. I didn't know. But I can protect you.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_70.m: And how can you do that? Have you ever done anything like this before?
r: Well, actually, I have. In fact, I just finished protecting this entire town from a giant snake.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_76.m: Well, if that's the case, then I will tell you my story.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_77.m: My story starts a very long time ago, when I was just a kid.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_78.m: You see, one day, my best friend Addie and I were playing amongst the trees south of town when we encountered her.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_79.m: She was a young beautiful woman, but terrifyingly alluring. So much so, that she easily coerced us into following her into her house.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_80.m: Now, I will tell you right now that I have chosen to block out most of the details as it was such a painful experience.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_81.m: All I remember was being kept in a dark room for what felt like weeks without food and being alone. You see, the witch kept Addie in another room ... I think.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_82.m: Yes. You see, after I escaped, I never saw Addie again.

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_83.m: After a couple of weeks passed, I saw a chance to escape and I took it. Never to look back and never to talk about it. Well, until now.
r: Thank you for telling me your story. I want to stop this witch once and for all. Where can I find her?

fallhaven_outdoor_farmer_84.m: Thank you! You can find her house just south of here. You can't miss it as it is covered in beautiful flowers.

wicked_witch.10: Bela, the Fallhaven tavern keeper heard from a customer about a possible kidnapping of a girl. I should ask around town if anyone knows more.
wicked_witch.20: The "busy farmer", in the southeastern part of Fallhaven knows something about the witch.
wicked_witch.30: The "busy farmer" and his best friend, Addie, were kept captive by the witch a very long time ago when they were just kids. He never saw Addie again.
wicked_witch.40: The "busy farmer" told me that the witch's house is just south of Fallhaven. Covered in beautiful flowers.
wicked_witch.50: After meeting Bonicksa, the wicked witch, I decided to let her live and she did likewise, but not before leaving me with a very cryptic response. Saying I was "confident in my path" and that "we shall see". I wonder what that meant?
wicked_witch.60: I killed what I thought was Bonicksa, but I quickly realized that I killed an innocent girl.
wicked_witch.65: I "killed" Bonicksa again, only for her to reappear.
wicked_witch.70: Bonicksa lives and could not be defeated. But I learned a huge life lesson.
wicked_witch.80: I discovered a young girl named Emmeline just behind the 'wicked witch's' house. The witch was really Emmeline under a spell from Bonicksa.
wicked_witch.85: Emmeline asked me to get her "a lot" of those "Tonics of Blood".
wicked_witch.90: Emmeline told me to head east of the witch's house to find the undead that know about the 'Tonic of Blood'.
wicked_witch.95: I gave Emmeline 25 of the "Tonics of Blood" that she asked for and she was then able to leave that terrible place.
wicked_witch.96: I gave Emmeline 20 of the 25 "Tonics of Blood" that she asked for and she was then able to leave that terrible place.
